D.t: Ben Ray Luján leads by 21.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 175,742 votes; a one point swing is about 4,093 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +13.3 and D +29.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +19.4. Your best recent poll is Research Co. at D +20.0; your worst is Research & Polling Inc. at D +17.0. 3 polls in the last 30 days.
